blocks.title: Model
blocks.text: A model is a simplified way of looking at a complex problem or situation that helps us understand, explain or predict how things work, focusing on the most important parts and leaving out unnecessary details, just as a map shows roads and landmarks.
A student's study plan is a model: it simplifies the schedule by focusing on important subjects and ignoring less relevant tasks.

blocks.prompt: What is the importance of building statistical models in real-world applications (short question 1)?
blocks.explanation: They turn data into understanding and predictions: they reveal relationships, forecast outcomes such as earnings or weather, and support decisions in business, health, farming and research, while showing how uncertain those predictions are.

items: Model: a simplified map of a problem used to understand, explain or predict.
